
		<h2>

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Burpsuite靶场-jwt漏洞原理总结及复现</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3541082/202603/3541082-20260311124759776-1509454875.png" alt="Burpsuite靶场-jwt漏洞原理总结及复现" class="desc_img">
        笔记系统性地记录了JWT（JSON Web Token）的六种常见安全漏洞原理与靶场复现过程。核心内容包括：未验证签名、有缺陷的签名验证（如使用none算法）、弱签名密钥破解、JWK（JSON Web Key）头注入、JKU（JWK Set URL）头注入以及通过kid头进行路径遍历。每种漏洞都通过Burp Suite等工具进行了实际操作演示，并提供了绕过认证、伪造管理员身份以删除目标用户的具体步骤
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<hr>
<h2 id="一未验证签名绕过jwt认证">一.未验证签名绕过JWT认证</h2>
<p><strong>靶场地址</strong>:<a href="https://portswigger.net/web-security/jwt/lab-jwt-authentication-bypass-via-unverified-signature" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实验室：通过未验证签名绕过JWT认证 |网络安全学院</a></p>
<p><strong>原理</strong>:<br>
由于服务器未对<code>jwt</code>签名进行验证,导致任何人生成的<code>jwt</code>都可以通过认证</p>
<p><strong>靶场复现</strong>:<br>
准备工具:<br>
<code>burpsuite</code>加上<code>jwt editor</code>插件拓展</p>
<p><strong>目的</strong>:<br>
伪造用户访问后台<code>/admin</code>,越权删除账户<code>carlos</code></p>
<p>1.启动靶场,登录账号密码 <code>wiener:peter</code>,抓取带有自身jwt的数据包进行修改<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310205014075.png" class="lazyload"><br>
显示401 未授权,需要<code>administrator</code>用户才可以访问<code>/admin</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310205548108.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.发送到<code>repeater</code>模块,点击<code>Json Web Token</code>直接修改sub的值为<code>administrator</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310205347511.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>成功<code>200</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310205659478.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>可以来到浏览器替换jwt访问<code>/admin</code>页面点击删除,也可以直接在<code>burpsuit</code>上修改<code>url</code>访问路径<code>/admin/delete?username=carlos</code>删除用户<br>
这里我替换好了<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310205959556.png" class="lazyload"><br>
这里直接删除就好了</p>
<h2 id="二通过有缺陷的签名验证实现jwt认证绕过">二.通过有缺陷的签名验证实现JWT认证绕过</h2>
<p><strong>靶场地址</strong>:<br>
<a href="https://portswigger.net/web-security/jwt/lab-jwt-authentication-bypass-via-flawed-signature-verification" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实验：通过有缺陷的签名验证绕过JWT认证 |网络安全学院</a></p>
<p><strong>原理:</strong><br>
服务器允许签名算法为空,可以将签名算法改成<code>none</code>,从而伪造签名</p>
<p><strong>复现</strong>:<br>
1.前面的一系列登录,抓包,操作与上一个一致,只有修改签名使用的算法,改成<code>none</code>即可<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310211051405.png" class="lazyload"><br>
修改之后<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310211144060.png" class="lazyload"><br>
由此401变成200,可以重复上一个操作了,将有效jwt复制或者直接接口删除用户</p>
<h2 id="三通过弱签名密钥绕过jwt认证">三.通过弱签名密钥绕过JWT认证</h2>
<p><strong>靶场地址</strong>:<br>
<a href="https://portswigger.net/web-security/jwt/lab-jwt-authentication-bypass-via-weak-signing-key" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实验室：通过弱签名密钥绕过JWT认证 |网络安全学院</a></p>
<p><strong>准备工具</strong>:<br>
<a href="https://github.com/ticarpi/jwt_tool.git" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">jwt_tool</a>工具</p>
<p><strong>原理:</strong><br>
由于签名使用对称加密,并且加密的密钥泄露或者使用的弱密码造成攻击者可以使用该密钥伪造jwt</p>
<p>复现:</p>
<p>1.登录,抓包,获取<code>jwt</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310212229740.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.使用<code>jwt_tool</code>工具进行破解</p>
<p>字典在题目上给了<code>jwt.secrets.list</code>文件</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">python jwt_tool.py &lt;JWT&gt; -C -d jwt.secrets.list
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310214125093.png" class="lazyload">=<br>
成功获取了密码</p>
<p>3.使用<a href="https://www.jwt.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">jwt.io</a>网站使用密码验证,并且修改<br>
<strong>验证</strong><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310214451955.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<strong>修改</strong></p>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310214544988.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>将右边的有效<code>jwt</code>复制即可,同上</p>
<h2 id="四通过jwk头注入实现jwt认证绕过">四.通过JWK头注入实现JWT认证绕过</h2>
<p><strong>靶场地址</strong>:<br>
<a href="https://portswigger.net/web-security/jwt/lab-jwt-authentication-bypass-via-jwk-header-injection" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实验：通过JWK头注入实现JWT认证绕过 |Web Security Academy</a><br>
<strong>原理:</strong><br>
<code>JWK</code>内嵌公钥攻击,就是<code>jwt</code>将公钥放在头部,攻击者通过修改头部控制 <code>JWT </code>验证所使用的公钥,从而使攻击者变成了签发<code> JWT</code> 的人.</p>
<p><code>JWT header </code>允许：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{  
 "alg":"RS256",  
 "jwk":{  
   "kty":"RSA",  
   "n":"攻击者公钥",  
   "e":"AQAB"  
 }  
}
</code></pre>
<p>如果服务器：</p>
<pre><code>直接使用 header.jwk 验证
</code></pre>
<p>攻击者：</p>
<ul>
<li>用自己私钥签名</li>
<li>把公钥放 header<br>
服务器验证成功。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>复现:</strong></p>
<p>1.获取带有自己<code>jwt</code>的<code>/admin</code>包发送到<code>repeater</code>模块,使用<code>jwt editor</code>生成新的<code>rsa key</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310215427231.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310215449004.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>成功生成<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310215514128.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.在<code>repeater</code>模块,注入自己的<code>rsa公钥</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310215708732.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3.修改用户之后还要点一下<code>sign</code>进行签名<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310215914085.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310215935442.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><mark>注意</mark>:如果生成过多个key的话,要选择对应的,不要选错了</p>
<p>4.发送数据,已经变成200,可以访问了,可以直接删除用户了</p>
<h2 id="五通过jku头注入绕过jwt认证">五.通过JKU头注入绕过JWT认证</h2>
<p><strong>靶场地址</strong>:<br>
<a href="https://portswigger.net/web-security/jwt/lab-jwt-authentication-bypass-via-jku-header-injection" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实验：通过JKU头注入绕过JWT认证 |网络安全学院</a></p>
<p><strong>原理:</strong><br>
与上一个类似,上一个是直接使用头部的公钥进行验证,这一个则是头部使用<code>jku</code>字段,加载远程的公钥字段,攻击者只需要搭建一个远程服务器构造特定的返回公钥值,就可以实现绕过认证.</p>
<p><code>JWT header </code>支持字段：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "alg": "RS256",
  "jku": "https://attacker.com/jwks.json",
  "kid": "hack"
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>jku</code> = JSON Web Key URL<br>
含义:指定<code> JWKS</code> 地址</p>
<p><code>JWKS</code>格式:</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{  
"keys":[  
	{  
	"kid":"hack",  
	"kty":"RSA",  
	"n":"攻击者公钥",  
	"e":"AQAB"  
	}  
   ]  
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>复现:</strong><br>
1.同上获取数据包,并且通过<code>jwt editor</code>生成<code>rsa key</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310221549648.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.复制<code>jwk</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310221626432.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3.去提供的漏洞服务器,构造恶意<code>url</code></p>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310221740439.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>将刚刚复制的<code>jwk</code>放进以下<code>keys</code>里面,构造有效<code>jwks</code>,并且放到返回中</p>
<pre><code>{  
"keys":[  

   ]  
}
</code></pre>
<p>添加之后</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{  
"keys":[  
	{
	    "kty": "RSA",
	    "e": "AQAB",
	    "kid": "fd9a2045-9d42-4952-919a-93a1e35a56ff",
	    "n": "uKtgYTLgMV3BBvLnLfcn_bSN-tRIbP_1oY7Gu3IxY51hLOSIPKiYeRbiI2fEZBmex6JJ7_YRf9SnQBIc_iyBOXNoZnUUZ5qJzPaI1O2mvmQhnXFHkcuMwneSyxQ1lok1SzeL45AalXwMwANCVqUz83VEziJrNc3fFS0RtoSYzsf3v6uJ82QsMWJ-QTZNhUibvd3BCOIh8aLL-IzFk48fRwcz3CBn0jgtNcx8OG97C6jt04vp0DYhf5ykdLBbzEb9UnM4HKVTrZXdNB2IwYMfPmwfXCoq-5cOLvC7i_mYsPdS6QmQyezTK824nvgKHA-qXO-wysFoQBlVKmJOM3avBQ"
	} 
   ]  
}
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310222039478.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>复制恶意url:<br>
<a href="https://exploit-0a9300cb04f1772a82f3bec4013d000e.exploit-server.net/exploit" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://exploit-0a9300cb04f1772a82f3bec4013d000e.exploit-server.net/exploit</a></p>
<p>4.回到<code>burpsuite</code>的<code>repeater</code>模块,<code>json web token</code>添加头部字段<code>jku</code>,并且将<code>kid</code>修改成我们刚刚生成的<code>kid</code>,还有<code>administrator</code></p>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310222336258.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310222517686.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>5.最后<code>sign</code>签名,发包,成功200<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310222754420.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="六-通过kid头路径遍历实现jwt认证绕过">六. 通过kid头路径遍历实现JWT认证绕过</h2>
<p><strong>靶场地址</strong>:<br>
<a href="https://portswigger.net/web-security/jwt/lab-jwt-authentication-bypass-via-kid-header-path-traversal" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">实验：通过kid头路径穿越JWT认证 |网络安全学院</a></p>
<p><strong>原理</strong>:<br>
有些代码写成</p>
<pre><code>key = open("/keys/" + kid + ".pem")
</code></pre>
<p>通过头部的<code>kid</code>遍历本地的签名文件来作为jwt的签名<br>
攻击者可以通过使用<code>../../</code>使服务器读取其他目录的文件,进行签名,然而服务器根目录<code>/dev/null</code>会返回空<br>
即可以使用这个来用空来<mark>验签</mark>,我们用空来<mark>签名</mark></p>
<p><strong>复现</strong>:<br>
1.一如既往登录将数据包发送到<code>repeater</code>,使用<code>jwt editor</code> 生成<code>symmetric key</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310224219491.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2.将k改成<code>AA==</code>,<code>AA==</code>是空的<code>base64编码</code><br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310224213326.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>3.回到<code>repeater</code>模块的<code>json web token</code>,将kid改成<code>../../../../../../../dev/null</code>,跳出到根目录的<code>/dev/null</code>,<code>administrator</code>记得修改<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310224556319.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>4.签名jwt,点<code>Sign</code>选择刚刚生成的key,确认</p>
<p><img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310224658267.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>5,成功200<br>
<img alt="image.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/hzhsec/upload@main/20260310224825320.png" class="lazyload"></p>
